title: How Hot Is Lava, Really?
description: Lava from Hawaii's volcanoes comes out at around 1,150 degrees Celsius, and it can travel for kilometres without cooling. Here's the trick it uses.
comment: Would you walk through an old lava tube?

scenes.narration: This lava is more than twice as hot as a pizza oven.
In Hawaii, it comes out of the ground at around 1,150 degrees Celsius.
As the surface cools, it grows a dark crust, while the inside keeps flowing.
That crust can close over the top, turning the flow into a tunnel called a lava tube.
Sealed inside, lava can travel many kilometres and barely cool down.
Some of Hawaii's caves are old lava tubes you can walk through today.
